Class HomininPaleoOccupancyCalculator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.HomininPaleoOccupancyCalculator
public final class HomininPaleoOccupancyCalculator extends Object
Analytical Hominin Paleo-Occupancy and Migration Dispersal Calculator.

Computes geographic occupancy weights, hominin clade affinities (Homo Sapiens, Neanderthals, Denisovans), migration corridors (Kelp Highway, Ice-Free Corridor, Beringia Steppe), and glaciated geographic boundaries across the Late Pleistocene and Holocene (-100,000 BP to present).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computeHomininCladeWeights

      public static double[] computeHomininCladeWeights(double lon, double lat)
      Compute hominin clade weights via orographic Voronoi gaussian blend.
      Parameters:
      lon - longitude coordinate in degrees [-180, 180]
      lat - latitude coordinate in degrees [-90, 90]
      Returns:
      6-element normalized probability distribution across hominin clades, or null if uninhabited
